# Multimedia Engineering Concepts

A comprehensive reference collection for developers working with video and audio processing, with a focus on [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org) — covering terminology, container formats, codecs, processing pipelines, streaming, and practical code examples in C (using the FFmpeg C API directly), Python, and Node.js.

**Disclaimer** : A lot of the information in this repo was generated by AI. I still need to review a lot of things to ensure that everything is accurate. Feel free to make a pull request to help me out
---

## Quick Start

### Using the CLI Reference

```bash
# Transcode to web-compatible H.264 MP4
ffmpeg -i input.mov -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset slow -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 192k output.mp4

# Generate HLS adaptive bitrate package
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -c:v libx264 -b:v 2500k -c:a aac -b:a 128k \
  -f hls -hls_time 6 -hls_playlist_type vod playlist.m3u8

# Normalize audio loudness to -14 LUFS (streaming platforms)
ffmpeg -i input.wav -af "loudnorm=I=-14:LRA=11:TP=-1.5" output.wav
```

### Building the C Examples

```bash
# Install FFmpeg development headers (Ubuntu/Debian)
sudo apt install libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavfilter-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev

cd examples/c
make

# Inspect a media file
./probe input.mp4

# Remux without re-encoding
./remux input.mkv output.mp4

# Decode video to raw YUV
./decode_video input.mp4 output.yuv

# Encode synthetic frames to H.264
./encode_video output.mp4

# Full transcode with resize
./transcode input.mp4 output_720p.mp4 1280 720

# Apply video filters
./filtering input.mp4 output.mp4 "scale=1280:720,hflip"
```
